basic_info.description: This newly renovated second-floor residence boasts a full bathroom and kitchen remodel, blending modern amenities with timeless charm. Featuring 2 bedrooms and 1.5 baths, the spacious eat-in kitchen now offers contemporary finishes while still showcasing stunning vistas of Twin Peaks and Sutro Tower.  The updated unit retains charming period details, including original light fixtures and large bay windows that flood the space with natural light. Revel in the warmth of hardwood floors and a cozy fireplace. Step outside to enjoy direct access to the shared roof deck, perfect for al fresco dining or relaxing with panoramic city views.Convenience is key with independent laundry facilities in the basement and two independent garage parking spaces. Additionally, a large basement storage area provides ample space for your belongings.  Located at 1180B De Haro, this home is moments away from abundant dining options with easy access to freeways and public transportation. Don't miss this opportunity to own a beautifully updated property in a prime location, offering the perfect balance of classic San Francisco living with modern updates and exceptional amenities.
